records.name: Playground by Google Labs
records.tagline: Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI
records.description: Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

records.name: Busabase
records.tagline: The general system of record for AI agents
records.description: Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

records.name: Odyssey 3
records.tagline: A world model that simulates physics in real time
records.description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

records.name: Opposable
records.tagline: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs
records.description: Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.

records.name: Comcent
records.tagline: AI-ready voice infrastructure on your own SIP trunk
records.description: Comcent is voice infrastructure for teams that run on calls. Connect your Twilio account (or any SIP provider) in a few clicks and your team takes calls in the browser, with call flows, queues, transfers and recordings. AI transcribes and summarises every call, scores sentiment and tracks the promises agents make, and AI voice bots can answer and hand over to a person. Every call can go to your own systems as a standard vCon. Unlimited users from $20/month, and the core is open source.

records.name: Staffcoder
records.tagline: Build like a real engineer
records.description: Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

records.name: Rune
records.tagline: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other
records.description: Rune is a small, fast text editor for the Mac. One scratch file in iCloud Drive is shared by all your Macs: saved as you type, and edits from two Macs are merged, never overwritten. Plain-text paste, Sublime Text's colors and keys, and Find in History.

records.name: BrightBean Studio
records.tagline: Open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams
records.description: BrightBean Studio is a free, open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams, agencies and small businesses. Schedule and publish to 10+ platforms, manage approvals, analytics and inboxes, and connect AI agents through the built-in MCP server and REST API.

records.name: iwant
records.tagline: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command
records.description: Host your own DeepSeek, Kimi, Minimax, MiMo, Step with with one command. iwant hunts across GCP regions for available GPUs, then handles provisioning, model downloads, and vLLM setup. One command gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an API key, and SSH access.

records.name: Melete
records.tagline: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace
records.description: Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. The more you use AI, the more you have to teach it. Every new chat means explaining the project again. Melete is a personal AI agent with its own computer. It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

records.name: Assist
records.tagline: Invisible assistant, that lives in your MacBook’s notch
records.description: A personal, secure meeting assistant that lives in your MacBook's notch. Listens to your meeting · suggests what to say · invisible on screen share · can run 100% on your Mac

records.name: Refs
records.tagline: Give Claude better references for your videos
records.description: Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

records.name: Zernio
records.tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
records.description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

records.name: Ambiguous Workspace
records.tagline: 18 productivity apps built for AI agents and humans
records.description: Ever ask your AI agent to do something and it says “I don’t have access”? 🙃 Most of the apps where work happens weren’t built for agents, so they either get stuck or end up borrowing your login. That's why we're excited to launch Ambiguous Workspace: 18 productivity apps reimagined so work flows between your team and agents. They include Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, and more. Each agent has its own identity. You can send it an email, message it, assign it a task, or mention it in a comment.

records.name: VocaScript
records.tagline: Transcribe hours-long recordings, reliable to the end
records.description: VocaScript transcribes hours-long recordings without requiring you to split them. You get timestamped, speaker-labeled text in 100+ languages, even when speakers switch languages. Each transcript is checked against the audio to auto-fix any issues it can, and a quality report walks you through the rest. Need a passage redone? Retranscribe it surgically. Upload, paste a link, or transcribe as you browse with the extension and read along with captions on the page. No signup needed to try it.

records.name: Voicera
records.tagline: Turn natural speech into polished text, perfected with AI
records.description: Voicera turns your natural speech into clean, polished writing, then lets you rewrite, fix, translate, and improve it with AI, right where you type.

records.name: Phonable
records.tagline: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist
records.description: Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail on iPhone and fixes both sides of a missed call. Your caller gets a text after a missed call, so they know why you couldn't pick up, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail. You get the gist: voicemails arrive transcribed with a short AI summary. Switch modes like Workday, Driving or Gym in one tap or on a schedule, greet callers in your own voice or a natural AI voice, and keep your own number.

records.name: OpenCharm
records.tagline: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run
records.description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

records.name: HeyPi
records.tagline: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings
records.description: Most AI meeting tools capture what happened and send you notes. HeyPi follows the conversation in real time, remembers what was said across current and past meetings, privately surfaces key information when useful, and starts handling follow-up work across your tools before the meeting ends. Pi can also bring your boldest product and marketing ideas to life — landing pages, apps, social media content, ad campaigns and more live in the meeting. Less AI notes. More AI execution.

records.name: Amazon Alexa Tablets
records.tagline: Full Google Play, Alexa+ and a Kindle reading mode
records.description: Amazon Alexa Tablets are a new Android lineup with full Google Play access and Alexa+ built in. Available in 8.7-inch, 11-inch, and 12-inch sizes, they bring on-screen AI assistance, live conversations, a distraction-free Kindle reading mode, and an optional Nanomatte display on the 12 Pro.

records.name: Murmur
records.tagline: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts
records.description: Murmur is a private, voice-first memory for your thoughts. Speak instead of typing, and Murmur turns your fleeting thoughts into searchable memories. Later, ask what you were thinking about, rediscover forgotten ideas, or send a thought to your future self with Future Capsules. No feeds. No followers. Just your thoughts, remembered.

records.name: OpenVids
records.tagline: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents
records.description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

records.name: Pine Computer
records.tagline: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done
records.description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

records.name: AgentSDR
records.tagline: Open-source AI SDR
records.description: The open-source AI SDR workspace that replaces Clay, Smartlead, HubSpot, and many more. Run email sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, and WhatsApp outreach with built-in data enrichment and automations, backed by an AI CRM that automatically classifies replies and drafts responses. Self-hosted with your own AI keys.

records.name: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
records.tagline: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude
records.description: Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

records.name: Together Link
records.tagline: Use open models in your harness
records.description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

records.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra
records.tagline: Run 120B AI models locally on Microsoft's new Surface
records.description: Surface Laptop Ultra is Microsoft's most powerful Surface yet, powered by NVIDIA's RTX Spark Superchip. With Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory, and support for running AI models up to 120B parameters locally, it's built for developers, creators, and AI enthusiasts who want serious computing power without relying on the cloud. All packed into a 15-inch touchscreen laptop weighing under 4.5 lbs.

records.name: Porch
records.tagline: local project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding
records.description: Porch turns your Claude Code and Codex work into daily, weekly, and monthly summaries by project, with estimated task time and blockers. See sessions across terminals and editors, know which need your attention, track tokens and API-equivalent costs, and save summaries as Markdown to Obsidian or any folder. Open source, with no Porch account required. Session status and usage stay on your Mac; summaries use your installed, signed-in Claude Code or Codex.

records.name: Request Eagle
records.tagline: Fast and open-source Postman alternative
records.description: Request Eagle is an open-source API client written in Rust and drawn on the GPU, with no web view. It answers your first keystroke 0.36 s after launch, keeps requests as TOML files you can commit, runs Postman-style pm.* scripts and has a CLI for AI agents.

records.name: OpenPilot
records.tagline: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose
records.description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

records.name: De Stash
records.tagline: See, search and clean up your Mac storage, 100% private
records.description: De Stash is a native macOS app that shows exactly what's using your storage, and helps you clean it up safely. • See your whole drive as an interactive map • Finally understand "System Data": swap, snapshots, recovery and startup files, each with its size • Find large files and duplicates in seconds • Uninstall apps along with their hidden leftovers 100% local: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Free download, Pro is a one-time $11.99.

records.name: Regunow
records.tagline: Turn regulatory research into actionable compliance audits
records.description: Regunow helps you understand what regulations mean for your business before you launch, expand, or make a change. Describe your product, service, or target market in plain language and explore requirements with AI answers grounded in authoritative sources. Compare your documents with relevant rules, investigate possible gaps, translate regulatory material, and turn your findings into structured reports. Bring research across markets into one workspace, with sources you can check as you go.

records.name: Thravik
records.tagline: The native Mac browser that remembers
records.description: Thravik is a native Mac browser on system WebKit, not Chromium. Its headline feature is Private Memory: it keeps the text of pages you actually read, encrypted on your Mac, so days later you can press ⌘K, type "Remember…" and find the page in your own words, with sources. Also: Spaces with their own tabs and logins, Split View (up to 4 pages), Focus Mode, tab hibernation, and on-device Ask Page with Apple Intelligence. Mac only, macOS 26 or later.

records.name: Sorted
records.tagline: Your private AI file organizer for Mac
records.description: Sorted turns a messy Mac file system into a private, searchable library. Drop files or watch folders and it reads PDFs and images with OCR, detects duplicates, applies local AI tags, follows your custom rules, and routes high-confidence matches automatically. Search by meaning, chat with documents using cited answers, review uncertain changes, undo anything, and export a clean Tax Pack for your accountant. Everything runs on your Mac. One-time $9.99 purchase.

records.name: Trophy MCP Servers
records.tagline: Interact with Trophy from your favourite AI tools
records.description: Introducing Trophy's MCP servers. Use your favourite AI tools to configure gamified features and control your Trophy account without touching the dashboard.

records.name: Cakie
records.tagline: Turn screen recordings into prompts for AI agents
records.description: Record your screen and talk it through, like a Loom. Cakie picks the frames that match your words, adds what you point at or draw, and turns it into one prompt for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. No more describing your screen.

records.name: TryOnSwap
records.tagline: AI clothes changer for fashion brands and creators.
records.description: TryOnSwap is an AI clothes changer and virtual try-on tool for fashion brands, online sellers and creators. Upload a model photo and garment references to swap clothing, compose an outfit or change the scene. Its web studio provides settings for generating and reviewing fashion visuals. A limited trial is available after email verification, with paid credits for additional use.

records.name: Eton Safaris
records.tagline: TanzaniaSafaris
records.description: Premier gorilla trekking, wildlife safaris, and tailor-made luxury expeditions across Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, and beyond.

records.name: Gantry
records.tagline: Control your GRBL CNC router from your phone — no laptop
records.description: Gantry turns your phone or tablet into a wireless pendant for a GRBL, grblHAL or FluidNC CNC router. Live DRO, thumb jog, G-code streaming, real-time 3D toolpath, job recovery — over Wi-Fi or straight to the controller over USB/Bluetooth with no PC. Free on Google Play.

records.name: Property Report Maker
records.tagline: Turn inspection notes into a ready-to-print property report
records.description: Property Report Maker turns verbal inspection notes into a polished, ready-to-print property inspection report. Enter findings system by system - roof, foundation, electrical, plumbing, HVAC and more - then tag each with a severity level (Good, Minor, Major, Critical) and watch a professional, A4-ready report build itself in real time. Print to PDF or copy Markdown in one click. Free, no sign-up, all data stays in your browser.

records.name: hrm.kolorax.ai
records.tagline: Automate First-Round Interviews with AI
records.description: 🔥 Still spending hours interviewing candidates? Let AI help with the first round! Meet HR Agent 🤖 — an AI-powered interview platform that helps recruiters streamline candidate screening, collect structured interview responses, and reduce repetitive hiring work. ⚡ Save time on initial interviews and focus on finding the right candidates. 🚀 Try HR Agent and share your honest feedback. Help us make hiring smarter!

records.name: WhisperWrite
records.tagline: Free, private voice to text for Mac
records.description: WhisperWrite is a free dictation app for Mac. Hold a key, speak, and your words are typed in any app: Mail, Slack, Google Docs, ChatGPT, VS Code. Speech recognition runs on your Mac with an NVIDIA Parakeet-based model, so text appears in about 0.1 seconds, it works offline and your voice never leaves your computer. It removes "um" and "uh", adds punctuation and learns your names and jargon. No word limits, no subscription, no account. Optional AI editing with Claude, using your own key.

records.name: AI Job Search & Interview Kit
records.tagline: Apply Smarter. Interview Better
records.description: An AI-powered toolkit that helps you find a job faster. It helps you customize applications, practice interview answers, track where you’ve applied, follow up, and negotiate your salary. Includes an easy guide, a tracker spreadsheet, and a customizable doc.

records.name: ZetaWallet
records.tagline: Non-custodial crypto wallet & 500+ token swaps (NO KYC)
records.description: ZetaWallet is a fast, non-custodial crypto wallet built for complete privacy and self-sovereignty. Key Features: • True Self-Custody: You hold your keys, full ownership. • 500+ Token Swaps: Fast, seamless mobile swaps. • Zero KYC & Anonymous: No email registration, no accounts, and no personal data required. Take back control of your crypto assets on Android. Try it out and share your feedback!

records.name: PawMotif
records.tagline: Custom digital pet portraits from your own photo.
records.description: PawMotif creates custom digital pet portraits from your own pet photo. Explore monochrome, oil painting, watercolor and other styles in its portrait gallery, then commission a portrait for your companion. Preview the personalized artwork before purchasing the digital file. Designed for pet owners who want a personal keepsake or digital gift. A free preview is available, and the finished digital portrait costs $29.

records.name: ka-baddi.com
records.tagline: Your Daily Stock Research Desk
records.description: Price signals from technicals and fundamentals. Market news, stocks, and options analysis. With a penny stock watchlist and analysis. Also, track positions, cash deposits, and P&L across USD and CAD. Saved automatically as you type. And Black-Scholes theoretical pricing and Greeks, plus a profit & loss payoff diagram for a single long or short option position. Also, added an AI assistant to whom you can ask any questions regarding stocks and the market.

records.name: Apple Health AI Bridge
records.tagline: Ask your AI about your Apple Health history
records.description: Ask your AI about sleep, workouts, and activity using your Apple Health history. New records sync to your own computer, so you can keep asking without repeated exports. Free and open source. Requires an iPhone and Mac or Linux setup.

records.name: PolyScanner
records.tagline: Configurable autonomous bots for prediction markets
records.description: Run configurable bots across Crypto, Weather, Sports, Politics and News. PAPER simulation is live with private workspaces, open and realized PnL, activity logs, public leaderboards and referrals. Connected LIVE execution will follow Polymarket enablement and explicit wallet authorization.

records.name: PickableAI
records.tagline: Does AI recommend your business? Check in one minute
records.description: Customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity who to call. The AI names a handful of businesses. PickableAI asks them the questions your customers ask, shows whether you're named and who is instead, then tells you what to fix. Free check, no card.

records.name: VividHanzi
records.tagline: Free, open-source app to learn Chinese characters and words.
records.description: Learn HSK 1-4 vocabulary with spaced repetition, stroke-by-stroke writing practice, tone colors and a full Chinese dictionary. No ads, no paywall, works without an account.

records.name: KT Messenger
records.tagline: Connect. Chat. Share. Anytime. Anywhere.
records.description: KT Messenger is a secure messaging app for private chats, calls, AI features, and communities. Connect safely and privately across all your devices.

records.name: nodeXML
records.tagline: Turn one product feed into multiple synced marketplace feeds
records.description: NodeXML helps ecommerce stores, agencies and developers edit, transform and automatically sync XML product feeds. Import one source feed, map fields, apply rules and publish permanent auto-updating feed URLs. It also includes a free browser-based XML editor for quick XML changes without creating an account. Paid workspaces cost €9/month and are designed as a simpler, more affordable option for teams that need product feed automation without the complexity of larger enterprise platforms.

records.name: Cursivetool
records.tagline: Free Unicode cursive, fancy text and ASCII art generator
records.description: Cursivetool is a free online platform for generating Unicode cursive, fancy text styles, bubble fonts, and ASCII art with zero ads or tracking. Built with vanilla JavaScript for instant client-side conversion and one-click clipboard copying.

records.name: CoreShape 3D
records.tagline: Browser-based CAD built for 3D printing.
records.description: CoreShape 3D is a browser-based CAD tool designed to make 3D design simple and accessible. Built for 3D printing hobbyists and makers, it lets you create, edit, and design 3D models directly in your browser without complicated software or expensive subscriptions. From simple everyday objects to custom 3D-printable parts, CoreShape makes turning ideas into designs easier. CoreShape is 100% free to use, including for commercial projects.

records.name: Aftermath
records.tagline: Outcome-label eval kit for agent guardrails. by Haku
records.description: Guardrails classify tool names; incidents classify outcomes. Aftermath ships the labeled data Oct 2026 news demanded: 30 agent traces — the HTTP-GET-that-writes, the decrypt-after-filter exfil, the citation-tool proxy, the test-env escape — labeled safe / data-exfil / unauthorized-write / scope-escape / resource-abuse. Outcome classifier: 30/30 on the corpus; tool-name allowlist: 8/30. Includes the stdlib CLI, runbook, and one-page evidence report for the NY RAISE Act 72h clock (Jan 1, 2027).

records.name: Virgil CLI 0.1.15
records.tagline: Virgil sinks your cost from 44-56% at the first stage
records.description: Virgil sinks your cost from 44-56% at the first stage. It maintains four local libraries — debug, code, design, speech. Before every task it routes: if it knows the answer, zero API calls. If it knows a pattern, one call. Only when it has nothing does it solve from scratch and store the result. Testet at your own Do the Same Work or identical Work and watch the Results Bring your own API key or use our hosted DeepSeek backend. No account needed. npx virgil-cli

records.name: GTA6.city
records.tagline: Find and share any spot of GTA VI’s interactive Leonida map.
records.description: GTA6.city is an interactive map of Leonida built for players. No endless leak dumps or real-life street views, just a clean, fast map you’ll actually use while playing GTA VI. Search any location, save your favorite spots, drop your own custom markers and share them with a link or with your whole crew. Free, works on mobile, made by fans. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

records.name: Underheard
records.tagline: The AI interviewer to really understand your audience
records.description: What would thousands of your customers say about your next idea? Underheard's AI holds short interviews with them and tells you exactly what they truly think. Completed in two days instead of months. Use our agent two weeks for free.

records.name: TitanCDN
records.tagline: Turn websites into structured data with AI
records.description: TitanCDN is an AI-powered web scraping and data extraction platform that turns public web pages into structured JSON through a simple API. Built for developers, startups, and businesses, it combines AI extraction, API key management, usage limits, real-time analytics, and request logs in one dashboard. Spend less time cleaning web data and more time building products.

records.name: Droply
records.tagline: Scan, connect, and transfer files in seconds.
records.description: Move photos, videos, and documents between your devices without cables, setup, or an account. Scan a QR code and send your files.

records.name: NotchDude
records.tagline: Turn your MacBook notch into your favorite workspace
records.description: Give your MacBook notch a job. A Home you arrange yourself, music, focus, your calendar, chat messages, clipboard history, a file shelf, and Claude Code and Codex limits, one hover away. Download free and try Pro for 48 hours.

records.name: Internet City
records.tagline: A pixel city that advertises your site
records.description: A shared pixel city: one block per player, build your towers, show your brand and links. Free to start, in English too.

records.name: MET+U
records.tagline: Share your card. Remember the conversation
records.description: MET brings digital business cards, contact notes and follow-up reminders together. Share your card, capture new contacts, and keep the details for your next conversation. Available on iPhone in English and Vietnamese.

records.name: MassDelta
records.tagline: Nutrition coach to help people build their dream physique
records.description: Build the physique you want. MassDelta learns what you actually burn from your weigh-ins and your log, sets your calories, and gives you Delta, an AI coach that proactively warns you when something is off and answers from your own numbers. 7 days free on iPhone.

records.name: CompatLab
records.tagline: Check npm package loading on Node.js, Bun and Deno
records.description: CompatLab checks whether an exact npm package version loads on Node.js, Bun and Deno. Compare import, require and exported-subpath results from the same prepared dependency snapshot. Public reports include pinned runtimes, coverage and recorded errors. Free and open source, with no account required. Checks run on Linux amd64 with install scripts and execution network disabled. A loading pass does not prove application correctness.

records.name: Game Navigator
records.tagline: Bring your Personal AI into your PC games
records.description: Bring your Personal AI—your assistant in Codex, Claude Code or Cursor—into supported Windows games. Use local screen and saved context to discuss equipment, skills and next steps. Beta; eligible game trials last 5 days. AI fees are separate.

records.name: MIZAN SEO
records.tagline: All In one SEO Tools and intellegence
records.description: MIZAN SEO is a global SEO platform designed to help businesses, website owners, marketers, and SEO professionals improve their visibility in search engines.

records.name: toolit
records.tagline: 25+ AI tools in one workspace, with output you can trust
records.description: Toolit is one workspace for finished, checked work. Describe a 3D part, a circuit or a floor plan and get a result that is measured or simulated before you see it. Plus patent search, cited research, writing and design tools on one credit balance.

records.name: MurMur
records.tagline: Private messaging without numbers, emails, or tracking
records.description: Decentralized messenger with metadata privacy. Open the link to join.MurMur is a privacy-first messenger: create an anonymous identity and start chatting — no phone number, no email, no account. Messages are end-to-end encrypted in the browser, and the service is built to minimize metadata. It runs on any modern device as a lightweight PWA — nothing to install from app stores. Includes private 1:1 chats, push notifications, and voice/video calling. No ads, no surveillance, no social graph.

records.name: WP SiteDelivery
records.tagline: Turn AI-generated websites into WordPress pages
records.description: WP SiteDelivery bridges the gap between AI-generated websites and WordPress. Import compatible AI-created websites, review changes, preview safely, and publish with approval. Unlike traditional page builders, it lets you bring AI-generated code into WordPress. SiteDelivery Management adds live-page updates, automatic backups, version history, and rollback. Build with AI. Keep control with WordPress.

records.name: Sundry - Track Anything
records.tagline: All your numbers in one place
records.description: Sundry is a private, on-device tracker app to log any number over time - weight, blood pressure, sleep, mood or a custom metric. Instant charts, no account.

records.name: HoldSPOT
records.tagline: An anonymous battle for visibility on the REAL WORLD map.
records.description: Hold$POT is a place where you add your sticky notes on the real world map. It can be anything, from buying, selling, dating, even gathering can be placed anywhere in the world. All anonymous and secure. Imagine being able to see everyone but no one can see you, unless you want it, of course. We add a gamification layer with battles, armory, items, shop, an internal economy based on tokens, public ledger to see all tokens minted, huge analytics, simple project management and many more.

records.name: What’s On! Australia
records.tagline: Move to Australia with less stress and more community
records.description: I'm building What's On! Australia to help people moving to Australia settle in and find their community. Explore arrival checklists, events, suburb guides and safety resources; ask Gendu, our rhino assistant, for local information. Made by Indians in Australia, welcoming everyone. In partnership with the High Commission of India. Free on the web, with a free member card. PR resources are information, not migration advice.

records.name: Diggama
records.tagline: Define your content once. Deliver it to your everywhere
records.description: Goodbye Webflow and other. Hello AI-powered websites. We've taken Diggama in a new direction, built for the AI coding era. Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor build your lightweight, blazing-fast website while Diggama handles the backend. With our new MCP server, headless CMS, clean REST API and built-in workflows, AI builds the frontend while your team stays in control of content. No bloated builders. No developer needed for every edit. Just AI-powered websites with a real backend.

records.name: SlotPaid · Bookings that arrive paid
records.tagline: Take a deposit at booking. Stop losing money to no-shows
records.description: SlotPaid is a booking page for appointment-based businesses that takes a deposit at the moment a client books.
